title: CSP301 demonstration lab with explicit preparation and reporting
authoring_status: Human/source-authored synthetic development input, frozen before new model matching. Not independent ground truth or an inferred real capability. Count classifier and separate geometry fields were checked against the source and parameter schema before new-profile model testing. Version4 removes twelve inherited off-topic no-coating boilerplate clauses which contradicted the separately declared panel preparation service. Numeric values, field IDs and the explicit gloss-retention limitation are unchanged.
description: Synthetic operating and reporting declarations for a customer-spec walkthrough. Explicit panel preparation, dimensions and reporting are included; post-cycle gloss retention is deliberately not offered. Not a real lab or independent evaluation gold.
limitations: Post-cycle gloss retention is explicitly unsupported.
Optional ASTM route is not declared equivalent to the ISO route.
Customer release approval remains a customer decision, not lab capability.
This example supports a walkthrough; it must not be used as production-accuracy evidence.
